The '''Flitknot speeder''', often simply known as the '''Geonosian speeder bike''', was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] built by the [[Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective/Legends|Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective]] and used by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:FlitknotSpeeder-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|250px|View of the speeder's undercarriage.]]
Unlike most [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] craft, the speeder could be easily piloted by non-Geonosians with minimal modifications. It was notable for its unusual [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]-forward design. The speeder structure flowed back aerodynamically from the pilot seat, ending with two stabilizer fins at the rear.

Standard models of the Flitknot speeder were fitted with pheromone systems that used the sensitive Geonosian sense of smell to relay information on the performance and status of the vehicle, and had a multi-yoke system of control. Altitude was set by twisting the handlebar grips backwards to rise, and forwards to go lower.

The [[Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective/Legends|Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective]] used many of the same components for the Flitknot as they had done on the [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class territorial defense starfighter]], including the inertial compensator and the gravity generator used to keep the pilot seated.

==History==
[[File:DookuGold.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] riding his speeder.]]

The speeders were first put to use by Geonosian perimeter scouts to examine new meteor impacts or track [[Acklay/Legends|acklays]] and [[Merdeth/Legends|merdeths]]. Standard models were not fitted with weaponry. Strike versions were equipped with a blaster cannon. Sometimes the speeder bike was modified for use by a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] for scouting missions.

[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] used a modified Flitknot during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] to escape from the [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|Stalgasin hive]] to his secret hangar. He abandoned the vehicle once he left [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in his [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|solar sailer]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> Dooku had at some point retrieved the speeder from Geonosis and used it to meet [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends#Duel on the Dune Sea|duel him]]. Following the duel, Skywalker stole the speeder to escape the Dune Sea and head for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Palace]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

[[File:STAPs_BSV.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Three [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] riding [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]] escort a [[tactical droid]] riding a Flitknot speeder.]]

At least one Flitknot speeder, painted in the Separatist color scheme, was used by a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Nuvo Vindi)|tactical droid]] to patrol [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] prior to the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] incident.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus episode">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>

During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], Flitknot speeders were extensively used by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]].<ref name="Landing at Point Rain">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> Many [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|Commando droids]] also used them on [[Battle of Kiros]].<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref>
Oddly enough, many Republic Naval troopers would used captured speeders to go to bars and other places on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. One was used by clone trooper [[Fives/Legends|CT-5555]] when he was trying to escape from other clones to prove his innocence when he was framed for the attempted murder of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>
